type get_fraction_csp3 = (_: {

smiles: string

type get_mol_mr = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

type get_ring_count = (_: {

smiles: string

type get_formal_charge = (_: {

smiles: string

type get_qed = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_num_heteroatoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Analyze fused ring systems (clusters of rings sharing bonds) and report their topology, aromaticity, and heteroatom content. Distinguishes fused polycyclic systems from isolated rings. type score_structural_alerts = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string,

}) => any;

// Return Labute approximate surface area (ASA proxy).
type get_labute_asa = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return fraction of aromatic atoms.
type get_fraction_aromatic_atoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return heterocycle count.
type get_num_heterocycles = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return aromatic heterocycle count.
type get_num_aromatic_heterocycles = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return atom stereocenter count.
type get_num_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Bertz complexity index.
type get_bertz_ct = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_kappa1 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;
